injuries.shortComment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.
Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
